Cameras and radar. Indoors or out. Battery or cord.

Parts
264 × 200 × 96 mmW × H × D
1.75 kgwith battery
81 Whabout 5.5 hours per charge
IP54sun, dust and rain
Specification

Everything a session needs.

Sensing
3 global-shutter IR cameras, 24 strobed LEDs, 2 radar heads
Measures
Full ball and club data, markerless
Compute
Qualcomm QCS6490, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.2
Power
81 Wh rechargeable pack + 65 W USB-C
Controls
2.4" sunlight-readable display, 3 buttons
Carry
Hidden grip, flush in the top
Design

Faceted, symmetric, built to be carried.

Power

Works with or without the cord.

BatteryUnplugged, about 5.5 hours. The pack swaps out tool-free.
CordRuns from any 65 W USB-C charger, even with no pack fitted.
BothPlugged in, it runs and charges at the same time. Unplug mid-session without a reboot.
Setup

Beside the ball, facing the golfer.

450 mmwindow to ball
100 mmahead of the ball, either hand
2.4–3.0 mball to screen indoors
0 mneeded behind the golfer

Open confirmations

C6490P I/O voltageCarrier assumes 1.8 V SoM I/O and translates every digital signal (sheet CB-10). If the design guide shows on-module 3.3 V translation, U60–U68 become DNP and the _1V8 nets are bridged.
Thundercomm C6490P ball mapU10 nets are final; ball numbers (incl. VREG_1P8 and the VBUS-detect GPIO) come from the C6490P HW design guide (NDA).
Cord-only cold startBench test: no pack, 5 V default USB contract only, SoM unprogrammed charger. BQ25730 must hold VSYS ≥ 10.5 V from its POR defaults until the SoM boots and PD reaches 20 V.
LED current loopBench: OPA810 + CSD18543 loop rise time and overshoot on a real 8-LED string; firmware trims the strobe bus (30–38 V) to the lowest setting that keeps the sink in regulation.
Camera aimStereo pair square and pitched 3° down, club camera toed in 7°. FOV sim: ball at address in frame for both hands, ≥ 240 mm of stereo flight at 5–20° launch, 155 mm at 45°. Confirm on a prototype.
SCL3300 inclinometer ($30)Cost-down candidate: drop it if the BMI323 holds ±0.2° levelling after factory calibration.
LED-board one-shot 8 µs cap value560 pF from datasheet curves; trim on the first LED board.
STM32G474 AF numbersPin map from DS12288 Rev 1; re-check alternate-function numbers vs Rev 6 in CubeMX.
TE 5787441-1 ↔ 787439-1 keyingHeader is keyless and receptacle is right-hand key; confirm polarized mate with TE.
Small ICs flagged ⚠ on the sheetsTPD4E05U06, TPD2E2U06, DAC80501Z, TPS61169, TPS7A4101, OPA810, Würth RGB, BQ40Z50 pin numbers: pull land patterns from vendor ECAD libraries (nets are final).
